input.quote: MSL will provide replacement value insurance coverage for consigned Products. IBM will be named as a joint insured with respect to consigned Products for its interest.
input.rationale: There is no insurance clause in the General section (16.1–16.21) or anywhere else in the Base Agreement, Statement of Work or the Loan/Confidentiality attachments. The only insurance-related obligations are narrow property covers: MSL's replacement-value cover for consigned Products (SOW 13.1 b)) and IBM's own cover for its tooling (SOW 21.2, where the insuring party is IBM, not MSL). Section 8 of the Equipment and Program Loan Agreement actually relieves MSL of risk of loss for Loaned Items. None of this provides commercial general liability, professional liability (E&O) or cyber/privacy cover, so the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) is not met on any material term. MSL is a services vendor that occupies IBM-leased premises, handles IBM and IBM-customer inventory and has access to IBM I/T systems, which puts the absence of liability cover in walk-away territory. We have inserted a short insurance paragraph as new Section 16.22 at the playbook's preferred limits, expressly preserving the existing consigned-inventory and tooling cover, with the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback available in negotiation.

ops.text:
16.22 Insurance

MSL shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (i) commercial general liability insurance of not less than one million U.S. dollars (USD 1,000,000) per occurrence and two million U.S. dollars (USD 2,000,000) in the aggregate; (ii) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than two million U.S. dollars (USD 2,000,000); (iii) where MSL processes IBM data, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than five million U.S. dollars (USD 5,000,000); and (iv) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Such coverage is in addition to the insurance required under Section 13.1 b) of the Statement of Work and Section 21.2 of the Statement of Work. MSL shall provide IBM with certificates of insurance upon request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a short insurance provision in the General section: MSL works at IBM-leased premises, holds IBM consigned inventory and accesses IBM I/T systems, and the Agreement currently requires only replacement-value cover for consigned Products. Our playbook position is CGL of USD 1M/2M, E&O of USD 2M, cyber cover of USD 5M where IBM data is processed, and workers' compensation, with certificates on request; we can accept E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M as a fallback.
proposal.summary: Insert new Section 16.22 requiring MSL to carry commercial general liability, professional liability, cyber and workers' compensation insurance and to provide certificates on request.
